name: Morizono Riho
source:
An university student.
Just like Satoshi, Riho is a botanist, normally she appears to be very absentminded, but she can be very active when doing things she loves. Using the summer vacation she has come to the countryside to look for unusual plants.

She quite likes this village because the nature in it and in the surroundings is intact.

Although she does attend to the same university as Satoshi, the two weren't acquainted before. Now that both stay at the same inn and both study plants, they have come to talk often.

She loves liquor (and is strong drinker).
